description: A likely-reportability view on a personal data breach (UK, EU/EEA, Switzerland), following the ICO guide "Personal data breaches: a guide" and EDPB Guidelines 9/2022: whether notifying the regulator and telling the people affected is likely or unlikely to be required, the factors behind that view, and the notification deadline. The controller decides. General information, not legal advice. Do not pass names or other personal data.

aware_at.description: ISO date and time, with time zone, when the controller became aware of the breach. Example: 2026-10-17T09:30:00+01:00.

encrypted.description: True if the data was strongly encrypted and the key was not compromised.

people_affected.description: Approximate number of people affected, or "unknown".

recipient.description: Who received or could access the data: a trusted internal person, a trusted external professional, unknown or the public, or a malicious actor.

recoverable.description: Whether the data has been recovered or deletion confirmed, is likely to be, or not.

special_category.description: True if special category or criminal offence data is involved (health, biometric, criminal records, etc.).

name: breach_triage
title: Personal data breach triage
